bottleneck.description: Maker of Dynamixel all-in-one smart servo actuators widely used in research and education robots; competes with Maxon, Faulhaber, U2D2/Cubemars/Dephy in smart-servo categories.

dependency.key_customers: Academic and research robotics labs globally, ROS/OpenManipulator ecosystem, Korean delivery pilots
dependency.key_suppliers: Korean precision component supply chain (motors, encoders), in-house cycloidal Dynamixel Drive gearing

editorial.notes: Dynamixel is well-known in the academic/educational robot ecosystem (TurtleBot, OpenManipulator), but smart servos are a contested category with multiple alternatives at varying price/performance points. Robotis is not a sole-source for any industrial humanoid OEM — production humanoids use proprietary actuators or harmonic-reducer + motor pairs from Harmonic Drive Systems, Nidec, or Chinese suppliers. The Dynamixel ecosystem stickiness in research labs is genuine but not a critical-stack bottleneck. Delivery robot business adds further contested SKUs. LOW.
